title: Concept: Live-reload script in a production page
description: A live-reload or hot-update client script in a response gives every reader the same view the bank has internally: The reload client keeps a websocket to a development server, exposes the build machine and lets anyone who reaches that socket push changes into the page.
applicability: Static exports from a development server and reverse proxies that expose the dev port.
risk: A reachable reload socket is a write path into the page from the build machine.
